personal.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
personal.bio: With 9+ years of experience, I design and ship high-performance web experiences with React, Next.js, and TypeScript—bridging design systems, accessibility, and measurable Core Web Vitals gains.

about.title: Building interfaces that feel fast and intentional
about.p1: I specialize in React and Next.js product work—design systems, performance budgets, and the craft details that make complex UIs feel simple. I partner closely with design and backend teams to ship durable frontend architecture.
about.p2: Outside feature delivery, I invest in documentation, mentoring, and measurable quality: accessibility checks, Core Web Vitals, and component APIs that scale across squads.

projects.title: Selected work
projects.description: Product surfaces, design systems, and performance-focused builds from recent roles.

proj-01.title: Component Library Contributions
proj-01.shortDescription: Reusable React + TypeScript component library adopted across the team's product surfaces.
proj-01.fullDescription: Contributed to a shared React component library that standardized buttons, forms, modals, and data tables across several internal apps. Worked closely with a senior engineer and our designer to translate Figma specs into accessible, well-documented components with Storybook stories.
responsibilities: Built 15+ reusable components from Figma designs using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Wrote Storybook stories and usage docs so other developers could adopt components quickly.
Added keyboard navigation and ARIA attributes to interactive components to meet WCAG AA.
Reviewed teammates' PRs and helped migrate two legacy apps onto the shared library.

proj-02.title: Analytics Dashboard UI
proj-02.shortDescription: Internal analytics dashboard with interactive charts, filters, and role-based views.
proj-02.fullDescription: Helped build a Next.js analytics dashboard used by the customer-success team. Implemented the chart views, filter controls, and data-fetching layer against a REST API, focusing on responsive layouts and clear loading and empty states.
responsibilities: Implemented interactive chart and table views with Recharts and TanStack Query.
Built filter and date-range controls with URL-synced state for shareable views.
Added skeleton loaders and empty states to smooth out perceived load time.
Fixed cross-browser layout bugs and made the dashboard responsive down to tablet.

proj-03.title: Marketing Site Revamp
proj-03.shortDescription: Rebuilt the company marketing site on Next.js with a focus on performance and SEO.
proj-03.fullDescription: Rebuilt the public marketing site from a legacy template onto Next.js. Implemented reusable page sections, optimized images, and improved Lighthouse scores, working from designs handed off in Figma.
responsibilities: Converted Figma page designs into responsive, reusable Next.js sections.
Optimized images with next/image and lazy-loading, improving Lighthouse performance from 68 to 95.
Added semantic markup and metadata to improve SEO and social sharing previews.
Set up a simple CMS integration so marketing could edit copy without a deploy.

proj-04.title: Task Board Feature
proj-04.shortDescription: Kanban board feature with drag-and-drop, added to an existing team productivity app.
proj-04.fullDescription: Added a kanban board feature to an existing React app. Implemented drag-and-drop card ordering, optimistic updates when moving cards, and smooth micro-interactions with Framer Motion.
responsibilities: Built drag-and-drop card and column reordering with dnd-kit.
Wired optimistic updates so card moves felt instant, with rollback on API errors.
Managed board state with Zustand and added subtle Framer Motion transitions.
Wrote unit tests for the board reducer and reordering logic.

proj-05.title: Docs Site with MDX
proj-05.shortDescription: Developer documentation site built with Next.js and MDX, including search.
proj-05.fullDescription: Built an internal developer documentation site using Next.js and MDX so engineers could publish guides in Markdown. Added client-side search and a versioned sidebar navigation.
responsibilities: Set up MDX rendering with a custom component mapping for callouts and code blocks.
Implemented client-side search over the docs content with fuzzy matching.
Built the sidebar navigation and on-page table of contents.
Documented the authoring workflow so teammates could add pages independently.
